title: Éveil de la Toupie
identity: Vincent David's Éveil de la Toupie is an alto saxophone and piano work published by Billaudot as GB10105. The publisher lists 44 pages, 8:30 duration, 2020 copyright, and rhythmic groupings 3/3/2/3 and 3/3/3/2 within a musette waltz. Billaudot labels it ‘difficult’ in its cycle 3 listing and identifies adults as its audience.

evidence.claim: Publisher identifies instrumentation, catalog number, duration, length, copyright, and describes the rhythmic pattern and musette-waltz basis. It labels the work difficult, cycle 3, and for adults; its page links a Calaméo preview.
Publisher page links its score excerpt to the Calaméo reader; the reader did not load in Chrome (empty response), so notation was not inspected.

review_focus: Inference: the specified asymmetric groupings and 8:30 duration make meter/rhythm, continuity, and pacing concrete review points.
collection_flag: Billaudot's catalog labels it difficult in cycle 3 and lists adults as its audience. This is the publisher's own placement, not a SaxoBrain level.
